name: scale
title: Scale
description: One answer on a row of numbers, from one end to the other.
use: A question answered with a degree: how likely, how satisfied, how hard. Each number is a label around a native radio that shares a name with the others. Name the two ends in scale-ends, since a number alone says nothing, and put the question in a fieldset legend or an aria-label.

instead.when: There are two to five named options that switch a view
The answer is a score out of a few stars
The value is approximate and the range is long
Choosing should show how everyone answered

keyboard.action: Move between the numbers and choose the one they land on

classes.name: scale
classes.description: The row: cells that share its width, 4px apart, on a fieldset or an element with role="radiogroup"

classes.name: scale-option
classes.description: One number, on a label: a flat face 38px tall and never narrower than 28px, so a row too narrow for every cell wraps; pressed, it sinks into a well, and chosen, it is a mark of ink

classes.name: scale-input
classes.description: The native radio inside the cell. It covers the cell and is not drawn

classes.name: scale-ends
classes.description: A line under the row with two names, one for each end

states.name: disabled
states.description: The cell is a flat well and cannot be chosen

example: Not likelyVery likely
